FAQ Payment plan

For the second year, Roadburn has a payment plan/installment plan option. This means that you can spread the cost of your ticket over three monthly installments.

In the first payment you will pay 20% of the total, and then 40% a month later before paying the final 40% instalment in month three.

Can I buy multiple tickets/accommodation options via the payment plan?

Yes – the minimal order amount is €295,- (i.e the cost of one festival ticket) but you can buy more than one, or add accommodation options to your order as you wish.

Can you give an example of the payment plan?

Order amount: €295,- (i.e 1 x 4 day festival ticket
Purchase date: 05-06-2026

1st term = €59,- (paid on purchase date 05-06-2026)
2nd term = €118 (paid on 05-07-2026)
3rd term = €118 (paid on 05-08-2026)

Do I need to do anything to pay for months 2 and 3?

No, the amounts will automatically be deducted from your chosen payment method. In the event that this doesn’t work (for example due to lack of funds), you will be contacted by e-mail to pay manually.

What happens if I don’t pay after the first instalment?

You would forfeit the money already paid and your ticket will be cancelled. This amount is non-refundable.

What is the latest I can buy via an instalment plan?

You can buy your tickets via an instalment plan up until December 31, subject to ticket availability. If you purchased on December 31, your plan would be paid off two months later.

Which payment methods can be used?

The instalments can be paid with Visa or Mastercard.
